publication.title: S³-LoRA: Sharpness-Score Sampling for Efficient and Generalizable Low-Rank Adaptation
publication.authors: Zhangyi Wang, Qixuan Wu, Linlin Yang, Yangguang Ren, Haoyu Huang, Sheng Xu, Zhongqian Fu, Haixia Pan, Baochang Zhang
description: Sharpness-aware online sample selection directs the training budget toward informative samples. Shared EMA perturbations and score correction reduce the cost of sample scoring, while selective updates accelerate LoRA fine-tuning.
通过锐度感知的在线样本选择，将训练预算分配给更有价值的样本。利用 EMA 共享扰动与评分校正降低打分开销，通过选择性更新加速 LoRA 微调。
